description: A set of strings for a list of the dynamic pseudo-type is converted to a list
notes: The spec's function call rules make a call erroneous when an argument doesn't match its parameter's type specification, which only an identical type or the dynamic pseudo-type does, and don't mention converting arguments; only the general section on conversions says that automatic conversion is attempted when values don't match what an operation expects. hashicorp/hcl converts each argument to its parameter's type with go-cty's convert.Convert before checking it (FunctionCallExpr.Value in hclsyntax/expression.go), and converts the set to a list of strings, although the spec gives this very case as a type that doesn't match a list of the dynamic pseudo-type.
